description: Neighborhoods at Risk is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Headwaters Economics; Tableau Foundation; Mapbox. This site offers convenient, free access to socioeconomic and climate data that can help communities visualize potential problems and plan adaptation to long-term climate change. A three-minute video on the site shows people how to use the tool. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Critical Facilities, Cultural and Community Services, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
